item.title: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
item.description: The Lahore High Court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture and its main square is a pleasant spot shaded by banyan trees.
item.content:encoded: The Lahore High Court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture and its main square is a pleasant spot shaded by banyan trees.
item.dc:creator: Diaa Hadid

item.title: DIY fertilizer is a blessing as farmers face steep prices due to the Iran war
item.description: It's hard enough being a small-scale farmer. Then the Iran war drove up fertilizer prices. So farmers are using a traditional Asian recipe to make their own. They call it a "labor of love."
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.S. moves long-range bombers from U.K. And, Israel allegedly warned before Oct. 7
item.description: A possible Iranian threat led the U.S. to remove long-range bombers from a U.K. base. And, Israelis are learning that their prime minister may have been warned before the Oct. 7 attacks.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Who will win the 2026 Nobel Prize in economics?
item.description: A thinly traded prediction market offers a starting point. We explore potential winners and the big ideas that could earn them economics' biggest prize.

item.title: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai win Nobel Prize in chemistry
item.description: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
item.content:encoded:
Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

item.title: Over 1,000 children are buried at juvenile detention centers nationwide
item.description: Researchers uncovered the graves of more than 1,000 children next to juvenile detention facilities in 29 states. At one Maryland gravesite, 230 Black boys are buried.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: An early flu season means it might be time to think about a flu shot
item.description: Flu season typically starts in October or November. But it looks like the flu started to pick up in September this year.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: 'Medicare for All' message attracts midterm voters buckling under medical bills
item.description: Midterm candidates are talking up Medicare for All, and in a poll 2 out of 3 Americans said they support it. The phrase speaks to a desire for radical change, though many don't really know what it is.

item.title: 3 years on, Israelis grapple with reports Netanyahu was warned before Oct. 7 attacks
item.description: On the three-year mark since the Hamas-led deadly attack, Israelis are grappling with reports that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was repeatedly warned by regional allies ahead of time.

item.title: Deep in Appalachia, a rail-to-trail project builds bipartisan support for a bridge
item.description: The Trump administration has been hostile to federal spending on bicycle and pedestrian infrastructure. But there's bipartisan support for a multiuse trail that would connect Ohio and West Virginia.
